author: New China TV
description:
Even the shadows are in sync! 
Students in Yanjin, southwest China's Yunnan Province, kick off the new semester with a sunlit kung fu break, moving with fans and foam sticks in perfect rhythm.
title: Even their shadows know kung fu!

author: New China TV
description: A serene encounter in the wetlands: Milu deer wade through the shallows of Poyang Lake in east China's Jiangxi Province, sharing the tranquil waters with flocks of egrets. The deer, under China's top-level national protection, were reintroduced to the area, and years of natural breeding have brought their population to around 80.
title: Milu deer roam alongside egrets at Poyang Lake

author: New China TV
description: China has deployed more than 2,500 rescue personnel after a mudslide struck Gyirong Port on the China-Nepal border in southwest China's Xizang Autonomous Region on Aug. 26, the emergency response and rescue headquarters said on Sunday. #XinhuaNews
title: Xinhua News | Over 2,500 rescuers deployed to mudslide-hit border port in China's Xizang

author: New China TV
description:
400+ representatives from 40+ countries and regions, along with UN agencies and international organizations, gathered in Shenzhen for the Asia-Pacific Media Forum.
As an important part of the APEC "China Year" events, the forum explored China's development and openness, and how media and think tanks can help advance Asia-Pacific cooperation.
What words came up most often at the forum? Openness, innovation, cooperation, connectivity ...
title: APEC "Keywords"

author: New China TV
description: 43 people had been confirmed dead and 519 others remained missing as of 6 p.m. Saturday after a mudslide struck Gyirong Port on the China-Nepal border in southwest China's Xizang Autonomous Region on Aug. 26, local emergency response and rescue authorities said on Sunday. #XinhuaNews
title: Xinhua News | 43 dead, 519 missing after mudslide hits border port in China's Xizang

author: New China TV
description: Local markets, global flavors! Thanks to efficient logistics and expanding market access with 264 new agrifood items from 79 countries approved this year, Beijing's markets are more international than ever. Get a glimpse into the lively buzz of the markets and feel the dynamic pull of China's trade in services connecting the world!
title: New Opportunities in CIFTIS | Global Flavors within a 15-Minute Living Circle

author: New China TV
description:
🤖 A recent survey suggests 69% of Chinese people see AI's benefits outweigh its risks.
So why the optimism?
Practical benefits in everyday life, stronger legal safeguards, and a society accustomed to rapid change could all be part of the answer. 🔍
title: Why do Chinese take a more optimistic view of AI?

title: Xinhua News | Iran's IRGC says attacked 2 U.S. Army vessels

title: Xinhua News | At least 21 killed in bus accident in Cabo Verde: official
